text: sed -n '/mod tests/,/^}/p' src/codegen_support/runtime/exceptions/matches.rs | head -40: mod tests { use super::*; use crate::codegen_support::platform::{Platform, Target}; /// Verifies the x86_64 matcher never clobbers SysV callee-saved registers. #[test] fn linux_x86_64_matcher_uses_only_volatile_scratch_registers() { let mut emitter = Emitter::new(Target::new(Platform::Linux, Arch::X86_64)); emit_exception_matches(&mut emitter); let asm = emitter.output(); assert!(!asm.contains("r12")); assert!(asm.contains("mov rcx, QWORD PTR [r10]")); } }
